lines.en: Coos as it flies over the treetops.
Carries a letter in flight.

lines.zh: 在阳光下闪烁着金属光泽。
lines.en: Shimmers under the sun's light.
Whistles to find a new task.
Skims through the leaves.
Perches on its owner's shoulder.
Flies through the gaps in the forest.
Follows its owner's footsteps.

lines.zh: 在空中划过一道黑色轨迹。
lines.en: Draws a black line in the air.
Carries a note towards the distance.

lines.zh: 爪下抓着一封卷好的信。
lines.en: A rolled letter in my claws.

lines.zh: 顺山脊的气流滑翔过去。
lines.en: I glide along the ridge's updraft.

lines.zh: 绕着屋脊飞一圈再落下。
lines.en: One turn around the roof, then I land.
Sits quietly on a branch.
Grooming its feathers.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出低沉的咕咕声。
lines.en: Occasionally coos softly.

lines.zh: 享受着温和的阳光沐浴。
lines.en: Basks in the warm sunlight.
Scans its surroundings.
Changes its perch occasionally.
Quietly waits for its owner.
Grooming in a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 享受着微风轻拂的时刻。
lines.en: Enjoys the gentle breeze.

lines.zh: 静静地思考着未知的远方。
lines.en: Thoughtfully gazes into the distance.

lines.zh: 用喙把羽毛一点点理顺。
lines.en: I smooth each feather with my beak.
Perched on a torii, watching the mountain road.

lines.zh: 把信压在爪下，等人来取。
lines.en: The letter held under my claw, waiting to be claimed.
I tilt my head to a distant bell.
I tuck one foot up to save strength.
I fly to your shoulder with a message.
Shows curiosity about your actions.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察着你的动作。
lines.en: Keenly observes your movements.
Flies to you for information.
Approaches you cautiously.
Stares at the food in your hand.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，主人一句话就到。
lines.en: I watch your hands, one word from my master.

lines.zh: 好奇地盯着你手中的信件。
lines.en: Stares curiously at your letter.
Flies to ask about the task.

lines.zh: 目光在你身上停留片刻。
lines.en: Pauses its gaze on you.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，正对着你。
lines.en: I turn my head straight at you.
A glance at your blade, then at you.

lines.zh: 你要听的命令，在我嘴里。
lines.en: The order you need is in my beak.
I land on your shoulder, light as ash.
I know the colors of your uniform.

lines.zh: 叫一声，是提醒你别走错路。
lines.en: One call, to keep you on the right road.
My eyes fix on your sword sheath.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我也正低头看你。
lines.en: You look up; I am already looking down.

lines.zh: 黑羽在你眼前晃了一下。
lines.en: A black wing flickers past your eyes.
I tilt my head at the blade on your belt.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，快带我回家！
lines.en: Wings hurt, take me home!
Ouch, come to me, master!
Save me, master!
Injured, need herbs!
Bleeding from wings, hurt!
Master, my wing is hurt.
My feathers scatter when I fly.
Come take me, master!

lines.zh: 翅膀被箭划开，飞不稳了。
lines.en: An arrow split my wing, I cannot fly straight.
Master, help me!
Caw caw, nuts sound delicious!
This fruit grove is mine!
Owner, give me some food!
Don't steal my food!
Caw, something yummy over there!
Owner, take me out to forage!
These berries are good!
Caw, I need fruit!
Owner, don't leave me!
Caw, found my owner!

lines.zh: 有米粒吗？我飞了一整天。
lines.en: Any rice grains? I flew all day.
Do not fob me off with bugs.
The letter first, then the food.

lines.zh: 你手心那点谷子，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the grain in your palm.
I perch at your bowl. Just one bite.
The rations are too hard; break them up.
Only a fed crow can cross the mountain road.
Hey, you're so reckless!
Owner, help me!
Caw, watch out above!
Caw, don't bump me!
Caw, get out of the way!
Owner, let's fly away!
Caw, this is dangerous!
Owner, let's fly!
Owner, save me!

lines.zh: 撞到我翅膀了，信差点掉。
lines.en: You hit my wing; the letter nearly fell.
Caw, find a mate!
Caw, this is my territory!
Caw, respond quickly!
Caw, you're a Kasugai too?
Caw, let's die together!
Caw, I'll be with you!
I tuck my beak into its feathers.
Caw, I want to reproduce!
Caw, come find me!
Caw, I love you!

lines.zh: 发出咕咕声，飞到主人肩上。
lines.en: Makes a cooing sound and lands on the owner's shoulder.

lines.zh: 张开翅膀，落在主人手中。
lines.en: Spreads its wings and lands in the owner's hand.
Flies quickly to the owner's side.
Bends down to peck at the owner's palm.
Cooing, indicating it's ready.
Finds warmth in the owner's embrace.

lines.zh: 落在主人肩膀，似乎在问路。
lines.en: Lands on the owner's shoulder, as if asking for directions.

lines.zh: 咕咕叫着，表示愿意跟随。
lines.en: Cooing, indicating willingness to follow.
Flies to the owner for protection.

lines.zh: 咕咕叫，确认主人的身份。
lines.en: Cooing, confirming the owner's identity.
Detects a threat, emits an alarm call.

lines.zh: 向敌人发出挑战，咕咕叫。
lines.en: Issues a challenge, cooing at the enemy.
Plunges downward, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，咕咕发出警告。
lines.en: Locks onto the target, cooing a warning.
Observes the enemy, cooing.
Approaches the enemy, ready to attack.
Detects prey, cooing.

lines.zh: 我落在枝上，盯住那只鬼。
lines.en: I land on a branch and fix on the demon.
Approaches the enemy group, cooing a warning.
Detects a new target, cooing.
Locks onto prey, cooing.
My black feathers rise.
Locks onto target, cooing a warning.
Locks onto enemy, cooing.

lines.zh: 鎹鸦传令，目标在你身后。
lines.en: The crow brings word: target behind you.
I do not peck people; I only carry letters.
Aims at enemy, cooing a warning.
Locks onto new target, cooing.

lines.zh: 我在它头顶盘旋，等你出手。
lines.en: I circle above it, waiting for your strike.
The moment it moves, I call it out.
Kra-kra! Peck at the enemy!
My master is attacked, I must retaliate!
Hold on to the enemy, don’t let them get close!
Kuk-kuk, the enemy is beneath me!
Peck through the enemy’s armor!
Kuk-kuk, I must protect my master!
Sever the enemy’s arm!
Kra-kra, the enemy is right in front!

lines.zh: 咯咯咯，让它们尝尝我的嘴！
lines.en: Kuk-kuk, let them taste my beak!
Peck through the enemy’s armor!

lines.zh: 呱呱呱，主人派我来送信！
lines.en: Kra-kra, I am here to deliver a message, master!
Kra-kra, a new mission has arrived!

lines.zh: 咯咯咯，主人需要我的帮助！
lines.en: Kuk-kuk, my master needs my help!

lines.zh: 呱呱呱，我回来了，带着信！
lines.en: Kra-kra, I am back with the message!
Kuk-kuk, roosting in the treetops!

lines.zh: 呱呱呱，我的食物是坚果！
lines.en: Kra-kra, my food is nuts!
Kuk-kuk, my home is in the forest!
Kra-kra, this place is safe!

lines.zh: 咯咯咯，我会保护主人的信！
lines.en: Kuk-kuk, I will protect my master’s message!
Kra-kra, seek out new missions!

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，快带我回家，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wings hurt, take me home! — and the fire makes it worse.
Hit rocks, hurts!

lines.zh: 好疼，主人快来，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, come to me, master! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 火药味里我掉了几根羽毛。
lines.en: I lose feathers in the smell of powder.

lines.zh: 主人救救我吧，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Save me, master! — and the projectile makes it worse.
A tuft of my feathers is singed.

lines.zh: 受伤了，需要草药，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, need herbs! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 羽毛全湿了，还怎么报信。
lines.en: My feathers are soaked. How do I deliver word?
In void, hurts!
